item.name: Ministry of Finance (Sweden)
item.description: Responsible for financial-market legislation. No minister is listed: after the September 2026 election the Speaker's exploratory mandate to Magdalena Andersson was resumed on 2 Oct 2026, so a new government had not been formed when this was checked.

sources.title: Talmannens sonderingsuppdrag till Magdalena Andersson återupptas
